req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the update functionality of the task management API. It includes a positive test to ensure correct updates, a negative test to handle invalid task IDs, and a boundary test to check behavior at the edge of valid input ranges.

tests.name: test_update_task_positive
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/1 with valid update data
expected: Task fields updated as per request
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

update_data = {
    "title": "Read chapter 6",
    "description": "Updated description",
    "completed": false
}

response = client.put("/tasks/1", json=update_data)

assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task["title"] == "Read chapter 6"
assert updated_task["description"] == "Updated description"
assert updated_task["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_update_task_invalid_id
preconditions: Task with id 999 does not exist in the database
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/999 with valid update data
expected: Error message indicating task not found
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

update_data = {
    "title": "Non-existent task",
    "description": "This task does not exist",
    "completed": true
}

response = client.put("/tasks/999", json=update_data)

assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 999 not found"

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/1 with title at maximum length
expected: Task title updated to maximum length
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "T" * 100
update_data = {
    "title": max_length_title,
    "description": "Boundary test for title length",
    "completed": false
}

response = client.put("/tasks/1", json=update_data)

assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task["title"] == max_length_title
assert updated_task["description"] == "Boundary test for title length"
assert updated_task["completed"] is False
